name: Clone Mirrors
description: Two opposing mirrors spawn illusory duplicates of creatures in the hall in an unending tide.
disable: DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to reposition each mirror, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract each mirror
routine: (2 actions) This trap loses 1 action for each mirror disabled. Each mirror uses 1 action to Spawn a Reflection of a creature reflected in the mirror. The hazard can have a maximum of four reflections spawned at once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spawn Reflection
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature is reflected in the mirror

Effect The mirror creates a Reflection of the triggering creature, which Steps out of the mirror and into the hall. The trap then rolls initiative.
